name: Dyngja
tagline: Your portfolio and simulated share trades in Dyngja
description: Dyngja lets you practise trading Icelandic shares with virtual money. Check share prices, your portfolio and past trades, and follow contests and other users. You can also buy and sell virtual shares if you enable changes.
examples: How has my Dyngja portfolio performed today?
Buy 10 shares of Marel with virtual money.
Which users have the most followers?

tools.name: market_info
tools.description: App settings: delayed market data and sale commission (no login).

tools.name: ads
tools.description: Current in-app advertisements (no login).

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Signed-in user and main business account with balance.

tools.name: business_account
tools.description: Raw details of the signed-in business account.

tools.name: stocks
tools.description: Tradable stocks with ticker, name and price.

tools.name: portfolio
tools.description: Virtual holdings, optionally for another account, user or contest.

tools.name: transactions
tools.description: Recent virtual buy/sell transactions.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Activity and performance feeds (recent, sales, purchases, historic, totals).

tools.name: contests
tools.description: List, search and inspect contests, participants and invites.

tools.name: users
tools.description: Search users, most followed/profited, news feed, team statistics.

tools.name: education
tools.description: Chapters, progress, achievements and videos.

tools.name: contest_ownership_totals
tools.description: Aggregated holdings across business accounts in a contest.

tools.name: contest_position
tools.description: A user's position in a contest.

tools.name: trade
tools.description: Buy or sell at market on the simulated market.

tools.name: follow_user
tools.description: Follow or unfollow a user.

tools.name: join_contest
tools.description: Join a contest by PIN or join a contest team.

tools.name: update_education_progress
tools.description: Record education progress for a chapter.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Change display name and notification/search settings.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback or a message to the Dyngja team.

tools.name: patch_business_account
tools.description: Change fields on your business account.

tools.name: reset_account
tools.description: Reset your virtual account (cannot be undone).

envVars.name: DYNGJA_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose write tools in the MCP server.

is.tagline: Eignasafn og hlutabréfaviðskipti með sýndarpeninga í Dyngju
is.description: Í Dyngju geturðu æft þig í hlutabréfaviðskiptum með sýndarpeninga. Skoðaðu gengi bréfa, eignasafnið þitt og fyrri viðskipti, fylgstu með keppnum og öðrum notendum. Þú getur líka keypt og selt sýndarhlutabréf ef þú leyfir breytingar.
examples: Hvernig hefur eignasafnið mitt í Dyngju þróast í dag?
Keyptu 10 hluti í Marel fyrir sýndarpeninga.
Hvaða notendur eru með flesta fylgjendur?
